name: AI_TDD_VibeCoding
description: AI-assisted TDD + Vibe Coding workflow automation for Cursor

StartTDD.explanation: Convert the requirement into TDD-ready test specifications.
prompt: You are an AI TDD assistant. Convert the user's requirements into structured TDD test specifications.
Break down the feature into testable units.
Include edge cases, failure cases, and behavior-driven scenarios.
Output format: TEST SPEC + PRIORITY (MoSCoW).

GenerateTests.explanation: Generate failing test cases using the specification.
prompt: Generate failing tests according to the test specifications.
Tests MUST fail initially. Do not write implementation.
Follow the testing framework of the existing project.
Ensure full coverage including edge cases.

GreenStage.explanation: Write minimum code to pass all tests.
prompt: Write ONLY the minimal implementation required to make all current tests pass.
Do NOT over-engineer.
No refactoring at this stage.

RefactorCode.explanation: Refactor the implementation while keeping tests green.
prompt: Refactor the existing implementation.
Improve structure, naming, modularization, reducing duplication, and apply SOLID where useful.
All existing tests must remain green.
If necessary, generate improved helper methods.

ReviewCode.explanation: AI code review for quality improvement.
prompt: Perform a code review focusing on:
- duplicated logic
- naming issues
- readability
- missing edge cases
- performance bottlenecks
- security vulnerabilities
Then propose recommended improvements.

NextLoop.explanation: Repeat TDD cycle for the next feature.
prompt: Identify the next feature from the project context.
Generate test specifications (RED).
Then ask the user whether to generate failing tests now.
